plugin.name: Marionette
plugin.description: Use when designing or building websites and landing pages, UI/UX and accessibility guidance, wireframing or prototyping app screens, choosing a product look, design variations, tweak panels or HTML decks, extracting tokens, auditing and polishing web designs, updating Figma, motion or GSAP and CSS scroll animations; creating, editing or converting Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files; implementing changes, coordinating specs and handoffs, reviewing changes or auditing a repository, shortcut debt or the Ponytail method and benchmark; idea briefs, design documents and their fresh-reviewer review, contract READMEs or design drift reports; implementation plans from an approved spec and their task-by-task execution under TDD; making and fact-checking HTML explainers; finding papers, a paper wiki, paper figures, planning and pitching research; or steering TokenEconomizer.

intake.goal: Extract art direction, layout, typography, palette and anti-slop checks; do not download photos, fonts or other external assets.
Extract motion principles, timing, easing, choreography and accessibility constraints; do not include unrelated GSAP library implementation.

intake.goal: Absorb TokenEconomizer's control surface and engine: the status, micro-skills, tool-pruning, settings and repository-state commands as one capability, with the engine packaged unchanged so those commands run from this plugin. Catalog its six default hooks as passive, host-approved entries and make registering or removing them an explicit user-requested action that first discloses their effects. Leave out the upstream plugin manifests, slash commands and skills as files, the Pi extension, experiments and tests.

Read the system prompt chapter by chapter and the fourteen procedural skills, and decide the delivery form of each part with the delivery protocol. Owner direction of 2026-11-12: this package spans many themes, contexts and intents, so the system prompt is not injected into every session; its content becomes capabilities found from context, harmonized and coordinated with the others. Compare its design rules, review passes and production procedures with the existing design, motion, deck and explainer capabilities and justify merges, separate stages or alternatives from source evidence; do not preassign the destination by name or source order. Leave out the Codex variant and the source's own list of when to invoke which skill. Record that the upstream describes itself as a reverse-engineered rendition of Anthropic's Claude Design system prompt, and carry its methods in the source's own words (owner rule of 2026-11-12, ADR-0017, which replaces the earlier instruction to restate them): the capabilities read the packaged skills and the chapters of the prompt they apply, and change wording only for a recorded collision.

Integrate Ponytail's six canonical working/review/audit/debt/help/benchmark methods into multidomain Marionette. Owner rule of 2026-11-12: the source's own rules file is carried in its own words as permanent policy, active by default and scoped to code work; its wording changes only where coexistence with another source or the catalog requires it, each change recorded in delivery.json. The intake also enriches the existing engineering implementation owner, merges change review and repository audit into one report-only responsibility with distinct intents, preserves requested shortcut ledgers and honest method/benchmark explanations. Published benchmark results are reference evidence, never measured Marionette or repository savings. The on-demand skills are packaged and read in their own words (ADR-0017). For the whole source slash routing, plugin installation, session/default mode persistence and optional band/statusline/dashboard/import/export/webhook infrastructure are inspected but deliberately outside this curated source selection: they are the original plugin product, not necessary to deliver the selected methods. Lite/full/ultra meanings may be explained as explicit task preferences without promising an absent global toggle. No upstream code or hooks run during intake/build; no telemetry or original native registration is adopted.

Owner rule of 2026-11-12: carry the source's communication policy in its own words as permanent policy, active by default: the whole SKILL.md body with its rules, numeric limits, examples and exceptions. Change its wording only where coexistence with another source or the catalog requires it and record each change in delivery.json. Drop only redundant source activation/routing and source plugin installation. Preserve all supported communication outcomes without inventing an on-demand capability. Source-native hooks, transport, developer QA and installation instructions were statically inspected and are accounted for in delivery and verification evidence; none are executed or registered.

intake.goal: Trial intake of 2026-11-14. Absorb EGM's method: an idea is developed and a design document drafted in the session that holds the context, and documents are reviewed by reviewers that never saw the conversation. Carry the seven skills (brainstorm, draft, review, review loop, resolve, bootstrap, drift report) as on-demand capabilities, with the reviewer personas, the document standards and the three host guides the skills open packaged unchanged. Register nothing by itself: the source ships no hook and its always-on rule for another host is routing. Leave out the upstream manifests, per-host adapters and wrappers, the site, tests and release tooling; the README, the remaining docs and the Claude adapters are read as evidence only.

Intake of 2026-11-14, owner direction: the planning chain in symbiosis with EGM. A spec or design document of this package (design-doc, concept-brief) is what writing-plans argues from, and the plan it writes is what the two executors run task by task. Carry writing-plans as one capability and the two executors (inline and subagent-driven) as one, with the method texts they require — TDD, systematic debugging, verification before completion, git worktrees, finishing a branch, the code-reviewer template and the per-platform subagent notes — packaged unchanged as the files the step opens; their standalone upstream triggers are not part of this package's scope. Register nothing by itself: the upstream SessionStart hook injects skill routing and competes with the coordinator, so it and using-superpowers are read as evidence only, as are brainstorming (concept-brief's ground in this package) and the README. Leave out the remaining skills, the hook trampolines, the node packaging and the release tooling.
